question: Which mantra-goddess is installed in the fire-pit and what is her creative seat?
premises: Either Mātṛkā or Mālinī may be installed.
She is installed in the form of resolve.
The triangle is the creative abode of the goddess of resolve and is of the nature of action.
inference: The rite installs Mātṛkā or Mālinī as resolve in the triangular, action-based seat of creation.
plain_english: One should install either Mātṛkā or Mālinī in the form of resolve; the triangle, which is the creative abode of the goddess of resolve, is of the nature of action.
